requirements.text: User can drag a board card onto the left rail to pin the ticket; the ticket appears as an icon-only item.
User can click a pinned item to open the ticket viewer for that ticket.
User can unpin via an x that appears on hover over a pinned item.
Pinned items persist across page reloads via the server endpoint (not browser-local only).
Pins from different projects render side by side in the same rail.
Hovering a pinned item shows a tooltip with project code, ticket code, title, and status.
Empty pin set: rail is absent (no horizontal space consumed).
Overflow pin set: rail scrolls vertically; items do not shrink, wrap, or overflow the viewport.
Rail is visible on board, list, and documents views (cross-view chrome).
Pinning and unpinning are blocked in read-only access modes; viewing pinned tickets remains available.
Rail render has no perceivable lag with up to 50 pins.
Drag-to-pin does not regress the existing board drag-drop for status changes.
Server endpoint response time is consistent with the document-favorites endpoint.
No new runtime frontend dependencies added.
Pinned ticket is deleted or moved out of scope: pin becomes stale; on next server sync it is dropped silently from the rail.
Pinned ticket status changes: tooltip updates; the pin itself does not auto-remove (auto-unpin-on-done deferred).
User pins a ticket while offline: mutation fails gracefully with a toast; rail does not show a phantom pin.
Pin set in server is from an older schema: migrated or reset; never throws.
Two tickets from different projects have the same numeric code (e.g. MDT-042 and OTHER-042): both render correctly; project code disambiguates.
User can enable/disable the pin rail in Settings; when disabled, neither the rail nor the collapsed strip occupies any space.
User can pin (keep open) or unpin (auto-collapse to a thin strip) the rail via the pin icon; unpinned still reveals on drag-to-pin and on strip click.

Rail open/close animates via a slide (~140ms ease-out); the rail FLOATS over content (position: absolute, 0px layout footprint) so board columns never shift regardless of rail state (open/collapsed/disabled).

scenarios.title: Drag a board card onto the rail to pin it
scenarios.given: the board view is open with at least one ticket card and the user has write access
scenarios.when: the user drags a ticket card and drops it onto the pin rail
scenarios.then: the ticket appears as a new icon-only pin item at the top of the rail showing its numeric code

scenarios.title: Click a pinned item to open the ticket viewer
scenarios.given: the rail has at least one pinned item
scenarios.when: the user clicks the pinned item
scenarios.then: the ticket viewer opens for that ticket

scenarios.title: Unpin via hover x button
scenarios.given: the rail has at least one pinned item
scenarios.when: the user hovers a pinned item and clicks the x that appears
scenarios.then: that pin is removed from the rail

scenarios.title: Pinned items persist across page reloads via server
scenarios.given: the user has pinned at least one ticket and the server PUT /api/pins succeeded
scenarios.then: the same pin set is restored from the server endpoint, not browser-local storage

scenarios.title: Pins from different projects render side by side
scenarios.given: the pin set contains tickets from two different project codes
scenarios.then: both pins appear in the same rail in recency order, each disambiguated by project code in its tooltip

scenarios.title: Hover shows tooltip with project code, ticket code, title, and status
scenarios.given: the rail has at least one pinned item
scenarios.when: the user hovers the pinned item
scenarios.then: a tooltip shows the project code, ticket code, ticket title, and a status badge

scenarios.title: Empty pin set makes the rail absent
scenarios.given: the pin set is empty and no ticket drag is in progress
scenarios.then: the rail renders nothing and consumes zero horizontal space

scenarios.title: Overflow pin set scrolls the rail vertically
scenarios.given: the pin set exceeds the visible rail height
scenarios.then: the rail scrolls vertically and items do not shrink, wrap, or overflow the viewport

scenarios.title: Rail is visible on board, list, and documents views
scenarios.given: the pin set has at least one item
scenarios.when: the user switches between board, list, and documents views
scenarios.then: the rail remains visible in all three views as app-level chrome

scenarios.title: Read-only blocks pin/unpin but keeps viewing
scenarios.given: the user is in a read-only access mode and the rail has pinned items
scenarios.when: the user attempts to pin (drag-drop) or unpin
scenarios.then: the mutation is blocked while clicking a pin still opens the ticket viewer

scenarios.title: Settings toggle disables the pin rail entirely
scenarios.given: the pin rail feature is enabled and the rail or collapsed strip is visible
scenarios.when: the user turns off the Pin rail switch in Settings → Board
scenarios.then: neither the rail nor the collapsed strip renders; the content occupies the full width with zero reserved space

scenarios.title: Pin icon toggles between open rail and collapsed strip
scenarios.given: the pin rail feature is enabled and the rail is open (pinned)
scenarios.when: the user clicks the pin icon at the top of the rail
scenarios.then: the rail slides closed to a thin strip that still reserves its width, and clicking the strip pin icon slides it open again; an unpinned rail still reveals during a drag-to-pin

obligations.title: Pin data model in domain-contracts (PinItem/PinState schemas, validation, types)
Server persistence: PUT /api/pins whole-list replace, user-global pins.json, validate project codes
Frontend pin client + usePins hook (load, add, remove, persist via authFetch)
PinRail component: 48px left rail, icon-only items, recency order, drop target, empty-collapse, overflow scroll
PinItem tooltip with project code + ticket code + title + status badge; hover-x unpin
Lift DndProvider from Board.tsx to App.tsx so board drag source and rail drop target share one DnD context
Mount PinRail as sibling of content in App.tsx content row (cross-view chrome, outside locked branch)
Read-only gating: block pin/unpin mutations, keep click-to-open and rail rendering
Design source of truth: pin-rail surface spec + mockups define the UX contract all behavior derives from
Browser-only pin-rail preferences (enabled + pinned) with localStorage + event broadcast
Collapsible rail states: feature-off (0px), collapsed strip (~28px), open rail (48px) with slide animation
